summary:
Plan of w149 written (plan.md). One red scenario: when the upstream runs work turn on a delivered request, the status is reset to accepted. The fix is a guard in scripts/workqueue_request.py turn: the r8/r9 status branch runs only on a request that is not delivered. The turn still passes (r7) and the request is still committed (r12).
The r8-accepted and r9 scenarios are green today and stay green. No test breaks (notes part 4, by search).
D2 (the asker's turn sets awaiting-upstream on a delivered request) stays, because r18 settles it. As a result, the real chain resolve -> asker turn -> upstream turn still ends at accepted. Closing that needs a new line under r18, which this plan does not write.
D3 (r15) and D4 (r1-r3) are outside the accepted r8/r9 and stay unchanged, reported for a later round.
